name: Naomi
note: An Israelite widow from Bethlehem who loses her husband and both sons in Moab.

name: Ruth
note: A Moabite widow who chooses to stay with Naomi and her God.

name: Boaz
note: A landowner of Bethlehem and a relative of Naomi's late husband.

name: Orpah
note: Naomi's other daughter-in-law, who returns to her people in Moab.

name: Elimelech, Mahlon, Chilion
note: Naomi's husband and sons. They die in Moab, which sets the story in motion.
